name: What are the signs that I need a new roof?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that I need a new roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating a roof replacement is needed include missing, cracked, or curled shingles; visible leaks or water stains on your ceilings; granules from asphalt shingles accumulating in gutters; and a sagging roof deck. If your roof is over 20-25 years old, especially an asphalt shingle roof, it's also a good idea to have it inspected by a professional. Early detection of these issues can prevent more extensive and costly damage to your home's structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing or cracked shingles, leaks, granules in gutters, or a sagging roof. An old roof, typically over 20-25 years, also indicates a need for inspection.
